videos.headline: JMU blocks Youngstown State's punt
videos.description: JMU's Justin Wellons blocks the punt and the Dukes recover for great field position.

videos.headline: James Madison strikes first with Kloosterman's TD
videos.description: After blocking a punt to get into great field position, James Madison cashes in when Bryan Schor hits Jonathan Kloosterman for the 14-yard touchdown to take a 7-0 lead.

videos.headline: Khalid Abdullah weaves through Youngstown's defense for gain of 30 yds
videos.description: Khalid Abdullah run for 30 yds to the YngSt 20 for a 1ST down

videos.headline: Bryan Schor pass to Rashard Davis for 18 yds for JMU's second TD
videos.description: Bryan Schor pass complete to Rashard Davis for 18 yds for a TD

videos.headline: Abdullah punches it in to put JMU up 21-0
videos.description: James Madison marches down the field again, capping an 87-yard drive with Khalid Abdullah's 1-yard touchdown run to put the Dukes up 21-0.

videos.headline: Hunter Wells pass to Shane Kuhn complete for 17 yds for Youngstown's 1st TD
videos.description: Hunter Wells pass complete to Shane Kuhn for 17 yds for a TD (Zak Kennedy KICK)

videos.headline: Ridiculous bounce turns into a JMU interception
videos.description: Hunter Wells' pass gets tipped at the line and then goes off the foot of his receiver bouncing up in the air to Curtis Oliver to make the interception and keep things rolling for James Madison.

videos.headline: Khalid Abdullah run for 2 yds for 2nd TD of the game
videos.description: Khalid Abdullah run for 2 yds for a TD
